Form of Return under Employees' Enrolment Campaign, 2017. 
Sir, 
The Central Government in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 read with 
sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions 
Act, 1952 (19 of 1952), inserted paragraph 82A after paragraph 82 in Employees' Provident 
Funds Scheme, 1952 to make special provision in respect of Employees' Enrolment Campaign, 
2017. 
Accordingly, in exercise of the powers conferred under sub-paragraph ( 4) of paragraph 
82A of Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, the Central Provident Fund Commissioner 
has issued order specifying the return ( copy enclosed) to be furnished by the employer in 
respect of membership of the employees who were to become members of the fund under 
the Employees' Enrolment Campaign, 2017 on or after the 1st day of April, 2009 but before 
the 1st day of January, 2017 but were not enrolled as members for any reason. 
This is for your information and necessary action. 
Yours faithfully, 
Enclosure: As above

were not enrolled as members for any reason.
